_readme: 'Around Boston' digest on the home page (design-explorations/README.md, option F). Takeaways are in our own words, never copied. The home page shows the first 5. Check each URL still loads before publishing. Last checked 2026-11-17.

items.title: Household Employer's Tax Guide (Pub. 926), 2026
items.takeaway: Pay one household employee $3,000+ this year and Social Security and Medicare apply to all of it.

items.title: Domestic workers: notice of rights and model agreement
items.takeaway: Working 16+ hours a week? Massachusetts requires a written agreement, and the AG gives you a free template.

items.title: Paid Family & Medical Leave rates and calculator
items.takeaway: A one-nanny household remits 0.46% of wages for paid leave, with no employer share.

items.title: National Database of Childcare Prices
items.takeaway: Daycare prices for every county, including Suffolk, Middlesex and Norfolk. The newest data is from 2022, so expect today's prices to be higher.

items.title: 2026 Salary & Benefits Guide
items.takeaway: A Boston agency's view of what nannies and household staff are paid, benefits included.
